features.agent_notes: loader.ts now guarantees canonical harness files, matches Graphify node labels against SUBSYSTEM_CONCEPTS, dedupes, and caps content at 6000 chars. mapper.ts now adds deterministic full-content signal mapping for all five subsystems, so misplaced identity, verification, state, memory, or constraints sections are not treated as missing when triage/classification previews miss them. scorer.ts uses strict course-aligned criteria and findings, and allows subsystem content to be scored as files or sections. remediation.ts builds generate/improve/source_context with examples/* template refs and max_lines=300. reporter/index write .aiready/plan.md, include remediation in JSON, and render multi-line subsystem blocks. --min-score is CI opt-in; normal audit runs exit 0 even when the score is low. spinner.ts is TTY-only and disabled for JSON/CI.
